facts.fact_text: On 3 February 2009 the first and the second applicants organised a protest demonstration in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
From the video submitted by the parties, it appears that approximately twenty individuals took part in the demonstration on 3 February 2009 in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
The third applicant was among the participants in the demonstration on 3 February 2009 in front of the Prosecutor General's Office.
Several minutes after the beginning of the demonstration on 3 February 2009, the protesters were attacked by six men wearing masks.
When the clash between the protesters and the attackers began on 3 February 2009, no police officer intervened.
The protesters called the police and requested assistance during the attack on 3 February 2009, but received no assistance.
A police patrol appeared only one hour and a half after the attack began on 3 February 2009.
According to Section 10 of the Assemblies Act of 2008, the organisers of a demonstration must notify the local authorities five days in advance about the planned demonstration.
Under Article 12(5) of the Assemblies Act of 2008, no obligation to notify local authorities five days in advance exists for demonstrations with fewer than fifty participants.

According to Article 67 of the Code of Administrative Offences, the failure by organisers of a demonstration to notify the local authorities in accordance with the provisions of the Assemblies Act of 2008 is punishable with a fine of up to 800 Moldovan Lei.
